tasks.title: Conversation #122
tasks.transcript:
Man: I'm considering taking up running to get in better shape. Do you run regularly?
Woman: Yes, I do. It's a great way to stay fit. You should start with shorter distances and gradually increase.
Man: That makes sense. Any tips for beginners?
Woman: Yeah, make sure to mix up your running routine to keep it interesting.
Man: Thanks that excellent advice. The weather is supposed to be great this weekend. I can't wait to get started.

questions.stem: Why does the man say he wants to take up running?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士为什么说他想开始跑步？ 定位原文：Man: I'm considering taking up running to get in better shape. 选项分析： A. To meet new people 为了认识新朋友。对话中未提及社交目的，所以A选项错误。 B. To improve his fitness level 为了提高他的健康水平。男士明确说“to get in better shape”（改善体型/增强体质），所以B选项正确。 C. To train for a marathon 为了训练参加马拉松。对话中未提及马拉松，所以C选项错误。 D. To explore new nature trails 为了探索新的自然小径。对话中未提及自然小径，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest that the man do?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士建议男士做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Yeah, make sure to mix up your running routine to keep it interesting. 选项分析： A. Buy appropriate running shoes 购买合适的跑鞋。对话中未提及鞋子，所以A选项错误。 B. Vary his workout plan 使他的锻炼计划多样化。女士建议“mix up your running routine”（改变/混合你的跑步常规），也就是让计划多样化，所以B选项正确。 C. Join a running club 加入跑步俱乐部。对话中未提及俱乐部，所以C选项错误。 D. Drink plenty of water 多喝水。对话中未提及喝水，所以D选项错误。
